items.computation: Trigger: 'ab dem Datum dieses Briefes' = the letter's own date, 19.11.2026 (Thursday). Under §187 Abs.1 BGB the triggering day itself is not counted, so counting of the 12 Arbeitstage (letter defines: Mon–Fri counted, holidays excluded) starts on 20.11.2026 (Friday). Counting Mon–Fri only, skipping Sat/Sun and any NW public holidays (none fall in this window): 20.11 Fri=1, 23.11 Mon=2, 24.11 Tue=3, 25.11 Wed=4, 26.11 Thu=5, 27.11 Fri=6, 30.11 Mon=7, 01.12 Tue=8, 02.12 Wed=9, 03.12 Thu=10, 04.12 Fri=11, 07.12 Mon=12. The 12th Arbeitstag is Monday 07.12.2026, which is itself a working day, so no further adjustment is needed.
